extracted.intended_audience: Prospective and current Spencer Foundation applicants (education researchers), grantees, and reviewers
extracted.subtask_description: Announcement of changes to Spencer Foundation grant programs and review workflows describing new preproposal steps, how proposals will be advanced to full peer review, changes to cycles and funding distribution, and feedback practices for applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to funding across disciplines and methods
rubrics_metrics.description: We remain committed to funding scholarship across the field of education from a variety of disciplines and methodological traditions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grant programs remain field-initiated and continue to fund research across topics, disciplines, and methods; reviewers and applicants should expect disciplinary and methodological diversity in funded work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for early-career scholars
rubrics_metrics.description: We remain committed to supporting early-career scholars.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program and review choices should preserve opportunities for early-career researchers; this commitment is maintained even as processes shift to manage increased application volume.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain rigorous review processes aligned with values
rubrics_metrics.description: We are working to manage this volume in a way that is aligned with our values, our deep respect for scholars and scholarship, and our commitment to a rigorous review process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Process changes (e.g., preproposals, advancing subsets) are intended to preserve rigor and respect for applicants while handling greater numbers of submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: No longer able to provide two peer reviews on every proposal
rubrics_metrics.description: For the foreseeable future, we are no longer able to provide two peer reviews on every grant proposal we receive.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Two full peer reviews will continue to be provided for proposals that advance to full peer review, but not for every initial submission due to unprecedented volume.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preproposal step for Large Grants and Research-Practice Partnership Grants
rubrics_metrics.description: All teams will first submit a preproposal, which will be evaluated. Then we will invite a subset of teams to submit full proposals that will continue through our standard review processes, including receiving two full peer reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In the Large Grant Program, the Foundation expects to invite about 500 teams to submit full proposals. Light feedback will be provided to teams not invited to submit full proposals. The intent is to save applicants time and preserve reviewer bandwidth while still providing in-depth feedback to many teams per cycle.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full proposals that advance receive two full peer reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: Full proposals that are invited/advanced will continue through standard review processes, including receiving two full peer reviews.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the condition under which the Foundation will maintain its prior practice of two full peer reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional screening step for Small Grants and other field-initiated programs
rubrics_metrics.description: For all other field-initiated programs, including Small Grants, we will continue to accept full proposals from all eligible teams. However, reviewers will evaluate all proposals that are submitted and then advance a subset of proposals through to our full peer-review process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Foundation will likely advance 400–500 Small Grant proposals in any given cycle. Projects that do not move forward to full peer review will receive only light feedback.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide light feedback to proposals not advanced
rubrics_metrics.description: We will provide only light feedback to teams who are not invited to submit full proposals or whose proposals do not move forward to full peer review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Light feedback is intended to save applicant time and preserve reviewer bandwidth; applicants should not expect detailed peer reviews unless advanced to full review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fewer cycles but more projects funded per cycle and overall
rubrics_metrics.description: We will have fewer cycles of some programs but will fund more projects in each cycle and more projects overall.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should expect changes to timing and cadence of opportunities; program-level schedules will shift even as total funded projects increase.

rubrics_metrics.name: Continue to provide feedback and invite resubmissions
rubrics_metrics.description: We remain committed to providing feedback to as many applicants as possible, and to inviting resubmissions across all our grant programs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Even with streamlined steps and light feedback for some applicants, the Foundation intends to continue offering opportunities for learning and resubmission.
